info.title: Thapsus-HR API
info.description: Versioned public REST API. All responses are served from the tenant's home region and are never cached at the edge.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

get.summary: Begin SSO sign-in (redirects to the identity provider)

post.summary: Create a workspace in this region (the caller has already chosen the home region)

get.summary: List or export the audit log (JSON page or full CSV/JSON download for a date range)

servers.description: Your workspace home region (uk, eu or us). Responses are never cached at the edge.
